notes.title: Implementation of the English version!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44929069/7c2b61342a47c54c02fd724033b990c299c53980.png[/img]
I had announced it beforehand in the news, but with version 1.10, I have implemented the English version of 'Fancy Rinshi Sensation'.

Implementation of the English version:
At the first launch, you can choose the language, and it's also possible to change it anytime in the options (Config).
I mostly rely on machine translation, so there might be some odd translations. I'd appreciate it if native speakers could discreetly point them out to me.

I've made additional improvements to the UI and addressed minor text corrections, among other things. For further details, please consult the patch notes for version 1.10.

During your first playthrough, the language selection screen will be displayed. For those who have already played, please switch languages from the "言語(Language)" option in the "オプション(Options)" menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44929069/463e4fc78872ff57bd6d166aacdfe7b3501ec9fa.png[/img]

notes.title: ver1.10 Updated! (Implementation of the English version, UI improvements)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44929069/7c2b61342a47c54c02fd724033b990c299c53980.png[/img]
Implementation of the English version:
At the first launch, you can choose the language, and it's also possible to change it anytime in the options (Config).
I mostly rely on machine translation, so there might be some odd translations. I'd appreciate it if native speakers could discreetly point them out to me.

UI improvements:
Enable the use of the keyboard for name input.
Pressing the X key allows for immediate actions like saving.
Some text and map event corrections. (I've relaxed some conditions regarding potential stuck-save points and added prompts to encourage players to save in advance.)
Removal of the always dash and command memory from the options, and addition of fullscreen settings.
Added a "Shutdown" option to the title.
Update of the bonus room.
Upgrade NW.js to the latest version (for profile error prevention).

During your first playthrough, the language selection screen will be displayed. For those who have already played, please switch languages from the "Language（言語）" option in the "Options（オプション）" menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44929069/463e4fc78872ff57bd6d166aacdfe7b3501ec9fa.png[/img]

notes.title: English version, in preparation! "Fancy Rinshi Sensation"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44929069/3b6e57ee2fe34a50d58b82333df9a7f4a48cae1d.png[/img]
Hello. My name is Horin HORII（堀井ほりん）, the developer.
[u][b]I am currently working hard on translating "Fancy Rinshi Sensation" into English.[/b][/u] Since the creator only has cheap English skills, they heavily rely on machine translation. Therefore, I expect there may be some oddities in the translation, but when it is published, I would be grateful if native speakers could quietly point out any odd parts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44929069/c1489bb21a8d9ea9930a43477171582142763057.png[/img]
[b]Coming soon![/b] (Target within the next two weeks)
